integrity: Complete exact enumeration of all 1048576 configurations with an independently decomposed 1024-state base-graph check; source programs included, no claim of independent validation or new infinite-family law.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns synchronous strict binary majority on the exact 20-vertex Desargues graph only. Graph doubling and the bipartite orbit count were previously known, so originality is limited to the numerical per-attractor basin populations and full first-entry profile. Priority against unindexed exact tables and independent external mathematical verification remains unresolved.
title: Exact attraction-basin spectrum for binary majority dynamics on the Desargues graph
